description: Keeps you in touch with people who matter, using your mail without being able to read the rest of it.

grants.note: To notice mail with people in the CRM (its triggers pick those people). A grant limited to mail metadata would be narrower.
To prepare check-in emails as drafts. Sending stays with you.

collections.name: relationships
collections.description: People you want to stay in touch with, and how often.

person.description: The person thing in your knowledge, e.g. person:ada@example.com

every_days.description: How often you want to be in touch

collections.name: touchpoints
collections.description: Each time you were in touch: when, how, what about, and what to follow up.

skills.name: check-in-voice
skills.description: How to write a check-in the way the user would.
skills.body: Short, warm, specific: mention the last thing you talked about (from touchpoints and their mail), one real question, no filler, no 'just checking in'. Sign with the user's first name. Drafts only: the user sends.

skills.name: touchpoints
skills.body: A touchpoint is an exchange: an email they sent or one sent to them that got a reply, a call or meeting on the calendar with them, a message. Newsletters and automatic mail are not. Record date, channel, a one-line summary and any follow-up promised, then update the relationship's last_contact and next_due (last_contact + every_days).

templates.name: log-touchpoint
templates.description: Record a touchpoint from new mail.
templates.prompt:
New mail arrived. If it is with someone in relationships (match their email), record a touchpoint following the touchpoints skill and update the relationship. Otherwise do nothing.

{{input}}

templates.name: weekly-check-ins
templates.description: Draft check-ins for everyone overdue, as one decision.
templates.prompt:
Find relationships whose next_due is today or past. For each, draft a check-in (check-in-voice skill) with memex.mail.draft through the call grant. Then ask one decision with decision_request: 'Send these N check-ins?', listing each person and a line of their draft in the document, options 'Send all' and 'Let me review', group check-ins. The drafts wait in the user's mail either way.

{{input}}

templates.name: follow-ups
templates.description: Remind about follow-ups that are due.
templates.prompt:
Find touchpoints whose follow_up is today or past and not yet done. For each, ask a decision with decision_request: 'Follow up with <name>: <what>?' with options Done, Snooze a week, Drop, group follow-ups.

{{input}}

memory.text: This realm is the user's personal CRM. It never sends mail: it drafts, and the user sends.
